text.en: 1. This Notification is the District Cooling (Declaration of Service Area) Notification 2006.
2. The area comprising the lands described in the Schedule is declared to be a service area where district cooling services are to be provided to the area.

3. A plan of the service area shall be available for inspection by the public free of charge at the office of the Energy Market Authority of Singapore, between 9 a.m. and 4 p.m. from Mondays to Fridays (public holidays excepted).
